description.en: Repair mojibake Chinese filenames in ZIP archives: encoding sniffing, CRC-verified extraction, a repaired ZIP with the UTF-8 filename flag set, and source-archive CRC pairing for irreversible U+FFFD damage. Includes an agent tool set and a sidebar upload panel.
description.zh: 修复 ZIP 压缩包里的中文文件名乱码：编码嗅探、逐条 CRC32 校验解压、生成置位 UTF-8 文件名标志的修复版 ZIP，并对不可逆的 U+FFFD 乱码按源包 (size, CRC32) 配对还原。含 agent 工具与侧边栏上传面板。

title.zh: ZIP 中文文件名修复器

description.en: Repairs mojibake Chinese filenames inside ZIP archives and extracted folders: 5 agent tools plus a sidebar upload panel (detect encoding, download a repaired UTF-8-flagged ZIP, or extract with correct names). Never deletes or overwrites the originals.
description.zh: 修复 ZIP 压缩包与已解压目录里的中文文件名乱码：5 个 agent 工具 + 侧边栏上传面板（体检编码、下载置位 UTF-8 标志的修复版 ZIP、或按正确文件名解压）。绝不删除、绝不覆盖原文件。
